title: MDx Governed Advisor Consult Receipt Payload
description: The payload of an advisor.call.recorded receipt (ADR 0490). A premium judgment consult is receipted so intelligence spend is auditable. Carries a DIGEST of the advice, never the advice text. Locked to crates/mdx-core/src/advisor_call.rs by make advisor-call-contract-check.

trigger.description: The high-leverage moment the advisor was consulted at.

advisor_model_id.description: The model id that played the advisor role.

provider_family.description: The provider family of the advisor model (retention and routing audit).

advice_digest.description: A bounded, whitespace-free digest of the advice. NEVER the advice text.

input_scope_hash.description: A bounded, whitespace-free hash of the input scope. NEVER the input.

fallback_model_id.description: The compliant model that answered when outcome is fallback; empty otherwise.

refusal_reason.description: The refusal reason CODE when outcome is refused; empty otherwise.

advisor_grants_execution_authority.description: Always false. The advisor is a judgment role and never holds execution authority.
